title: Parallax Arena - Shifted Veil
description: A dramatic fantasy scene set in a ruined stone arena with a wooden bridge over dark water. A tall blue-skinned female warrior with ornate golden armor and a crescent blade stands triumphantly above a hooded sorceress in purple robes who is casting a swirling blue magical spell from an open book.
prompt: A towering blue-skinned female warrior in ornate golden armor and flowing dark robes stands on a wooden bridge in a ruined stone arena, holding a large crescent golden blade. Below her, a hooded sorceress in purple robes casts a swirling blue energy spell from an ancient book. Scattered gold coins, broken pillars, floating candles, and magical artifacts fill the scene. Dramatic purple mist and arcane energy fill the air, epic fantasy digital painting style.
